activity.notes: Emperor Huizong (Zhao Ji) ruled the Northern Song from 1100 until his abdication in 1126. This Activity follows the political chronology used by The Cambridge History of China; art-catalogue year labels may abbreviate the reign differently.

sources.title: The Reigns of Hui-tsung (1100–1126) and Ch’in-tsung (1126–1127) and the Fall of the Northern Sung
sources.citation_text: Ari Levine's chapter in The Cambridge History of China identifies Hui-tsung's reign as 1100–1126 and treats it as the final major reign before Ch'in-tsung and the fall of the Northern Sung.

sources.title: Northern Song Dynasty (960–1127) — Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History
sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum of Art identifies Emperor Huizong as an accomplished painter and calligrapher and places his reign at the end of the Northern Song.
